name: kinetic-text
title: Kinetic Text
description: A thin variable-weight word where a pointer sweeps over the letters: the letter under it swells to black weight with an outline, and its neighbours follow at lesser weights.
useWhen: A word should feel alive with a wave of weight running through its letters.
A variable font headline needs an animated emphasis that moves along the letters.
avoidWhen: The text is long: letters reflow as their weight changes.
You want the letters to move rather than change weight: use per-character-rise.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The word. Letters reflow as their weight changes, so keep it short.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.description: Seconds the pointer rests on each letter.
